import Mathlib

def findImp (p : Nat → Bool) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat := Id.run do
  for c in l do
    if p c then
      return some c
  return none

set_option pp.all false in
#print findImp

theorem findImp_eq (p : Nat → Bool) (l : List Nat) : findImp p l = l.find? p := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [findImp, List.forIn_cons, List.find?_cons] at *
    split
    · simp_all [Id.run]
    · simp_all [Id.run]
